name: local-qwen
description: Plan with the model you selected in this window and implement with a pinned local Qwen worker on your own machine. Setup checks and installs the user-wide routing, doctor verifies an existing install read-only, and the launcher runs scoped jobs in throwaway git worktrees, returning a patch, real test results and an audit of every changed file.
